title: 50 Spam Messages a Day to Zero, No CAPTCHA | vitalii.no
description:
Within the first week of launching vitalii.no, my contact form was drowning in spam — 50 or more submissions a day. SEO offers, casino links, crypto scams, a constant stream of junk. I wanted it stopped without a CAPTCHA, which ruins the experience and makes a site look unprofessional.

I built a three-tier defense inside a single Edge Function. A hidden honeypot field catches bots that fill in everything. A timing check rejects submissions completed in under three seconds — faster than any human types. And IP-based rate limiting blocks anything over five submissions in a ten-minute window. All three checks run before the email is ever sent.

Spam submissions dropped from 50+ a day to virtually zero — a 98% reduction — with zero false positives, so every real inquiry still gets through.
